name: CF-PRIMARY
test: Part A: score the overdue CF forward test (Testing 1/2 + On Deck skip rows 10-30..11-25). Part B: CF-15 and CF-LL15 on the E4 book (BASE/LO/LO+L3-OUT) vs 500 same-share random removals + a constant cut; CHECK and T2 separately
pass_bar: dR/day>0; >95th pct random, paired t>=2.8 (3.93 global shown); red days/month down >=0.5; worst-5 <=5% worse; best-day share <25%; every Primary setup >= -2R/month

name: STOPX
test: Step 0 live stop-slippage audit; Step 1 C1 close-confirmed stop, C2 +2x catastrophe stop, C3 5-min close trigger; bench LIVE-L, Primary rules + LO
pass_bar: Paired dR/trade>0 on CHECK and T2, t>=~3.4; >=2/3 of setups improve; none worse >0.03R; worst-5 <=5% deeper; best-day share <50%

name: TAILEFF
test: LO, G1-3, LO+B8, LO+K4+SHOCK-V, LO+S8, LO+B8+K4 vs an exposure-matched constant cut; Z/RAW/P books; CHECK/T2
pass_bar: Z: E>=1.25, 20-session floor and days<=-10R beat the matched cut; P: red days +<=1/month, dR>=-40R/yr; no setup < -10R/yr on Z

name: BORROW-FLIP
test: Fix the recorder now; pre-register the ETB/shortable flip study; score once at 60 sessions
pass_bar: Residual short net>0, t>=1.5, same sign on SPY-up/down days, w/o best day >0; filter beats random skip at 95th pct

name: RESID-MAP
test: 20 cells (09:45/10:30/12:00/14:00 x 5 residual features), decile spread in bps net of LR8, FIT/CHECK/T2
pass_bar: Net>0 on all 3 splits; t>=2.45; w/o best day>0; best-day share<50%; same sign on SPY-up/down days

name: EARN-PRE
test: D-1 09:35/10:00 -> 15:55 long, no stop vs 1xATR stop; vs matched non-event control
pass_bar: Net residual>0 on 3 splits; t>=1.67; >=95th pct vs control; needs a blackout exception

name: SYMCOST
test: 0-config persistence gate on 32,131 live trades; then CF-LL15+SYM
pass_bar: Spearman>=0.3, CI>0 in both families; incremental dR>0, t>=2.0

name: RGAP-CROWD
test: Residual gap for L3/RW3/RW5 on |SPY gap|>=0.5% days; 1 config
pass_bar: Removed lots below random 10th pct; worst-5 better; Z cost>=-15R/yr

name: BLACKOUT-SURV
test: Lift blackout days 0/+1 for the trio; (b) |residual gap|>=2%
pass_bar: Added trades avg R and residual R>0 on CHECK/T2; worst-5 not >10% deeper

name: EXCESS-BOOK
test: Frozen excess legs + netted SPY/IWM overlay (6R band); random-book placebo
pass_bar: Book R/session>0 on CHECK/T2; t>=~2.8; >95th pct vs placebo

name: RESID-RANK
test: Rank setups on shrunk beta-stripped intercepts; top-4 vs total-R top-4 and 500 random lineups

name: RISKBUDGET
test: RB-VOL / RB-ALPHA exposure-neutral weights; 24-permutation null; owner yes first (rule 26)
pass_bar: Z worst-5 >=15% better; RAW dR>=0; best of 24 permutations
